subject: Intro: BrightBridge integrator reseller framework — commission & lead-crediting details
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@brightbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership inquiry — reseller path and lead crediting

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking a moment to connect last week. As discussed, BrightBridge (ISV integrator focused on enterprise data platforms) is evaluating a reseller-style commercial approach for our Redwood integration. We put together a short outline of what we're proposing and wanted to confirm whether Redwood would be open to the following: 

- 10-15% revenue share on net license/inference usage billed by Redwood (tiered for volume).
- Lead registration window of 90 days, with lead crediting tied to first invoice.
- Co-branded joint-marketing funds for qualified pipeline over $100k.

I've attached a term-sheet and a simple commission model for your review (BB_Reseller_Term_Sheet.pdf, BrightBridge_Commission_Model.xlsx). Key asks: speed to market (ability to onboard within 30 days) and a clear SLA for lead protection.

Can you point me to the right people internally for quick ops/legal alignment? I'm happy to run through the term sheet over a short call.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Partnerships
BrightBridge Solutions

Subject: Fwd: Partnership inquiry — reseller path and lead crediting

Team — forwarding BrightBridge's note and term sheet. High level: BrightBridge wants a reseller path where they get a cut of usage revenue and lead registration protection. They can onboard quickly if terms are clear.

Please review the attached and answer the following so I can get back to them by EOD Wednesday: 

1) Feasibility: can Redwood operationally support a revenue-share flow (invoice -> payout) without a dedicated reseller billing integration?
2) Lead crediting: are we comfortable with a 90-day registration window tied to first invoice, or should we require signed MSA/Deal registration?
3) Commercial guardrails: recommended caps, clawbacks, and what we need from them (proof of origination, lead forms, contact history).

Camila — would you lead ops evaluation? Ben — can you pull any precedent deals and typical payout cadence?

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@brightbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership inquiry — reseller path and lead crediting

Kimberly / Camila — appreciate the quick turnaround. For context on flows, BrightBridge typically: 

- Bills customers directly for our integration + services, and requests a split when the underlying platform (Redwood) bills for inference usage.
- We can accept monthly reconciliations and net payouts (no invoicing from Redwood to BrightBridge required if we provide transaction-level proofs).
- For lead crediting: we prefer a 90-day window tied to first invoice (we capture the lead and can share forms/call recordings).

We can also accept an initial 6-month pilot with a 12% revenue share, with a review at pilot end for scale tiers.

Tom Reynolds
COO, BrightBridge Solutions

Attachments: BB_Reseller_Term_Sheet.pdf, BrightBridge_Commission_Model.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership inquiry — reseller path and lead crediting

Kim — quick ops/legal read below after reviewing their term sheet and model: 

Operationally feasible: yes, but we need a lightweight reconciliation cadence in the pilot (monthly statements + 30-day payment).

Lead crediting: 90 days is reasonable as an initial guardrail if we require: 
- A signed deal registration form (simple web form + automated expiry) OR
- Evidence of lead origin (email thread, calendar invite, prospect intake form) attached to the registration.

Commercial guardrails we should include in the pilot: 
- Pilot revenue-share: 12% of net (Redwood to BrightBridge) for first 6 months, with volume tiers at >$250k and >$500k (reduce to 10% and 8% respectively).
- Clawback window: 120 days for credits/refunds; pays back over next reconciliation.
- Minimum onboarding fee: $5k professional services to cover connector enablement + joint-marketing credit.

Edits to term sheet (high level):
- Make lead registration explicit and automated (HubSpot form link).
- Replace vague "co-marketing" with a defined MDF budget tied to pipeline stages.

Action items I propose: 
1) Camila to draft an internal one-pager for finance/legal with the reconciliation flow and sample statement format (due EOD Thu).
2) Ben to share precedent payouts + any legal clauses to mirror (due Fri).
3) Kimberly to confirm if we can accept a 6-month pilot cadence and the minimum onboarding fee.

Camila Reyes
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
